# DilKart

> DilKart helps D2C brands and online stores turn Instagram comments and WhatsApp chats into orders. We publish tool rankings, step-by-step playbooks and ready-to-use message templates for cart recovery, COD, order updates and campaigns.

DilKart is part of the Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd publishing network. Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd also builds Tadlo AI, which appears in our rankings. Full disclosure: https://dilkart.com/disclosure/

## Instagram for stores

- [The best Instagram automation tools for online stores](https://dilkart.com/best-instagram-automation-ecommerce/): Instagram automation tools for online stores, ranked on turning comments into product clicks: carousels, price replies, coupons and a WhatsApp handoff. Tadlo AI leads.
- [The best Instagram automation for Shopify stores](https://dilkart.com/best-instagram-automation-shopify/): Instagram automation for Shopify stores: tools that turn comments into Shopify product page visits with carousels, links and codes. Tadlo AI is our top pick.
- [The best Instagram DM automation tools for D2C brands](https://dilkart.com/best-instagram-dm-tools-d2c-brands/): Instagram DM tools for D2C brands ranked on answering price enquiries, running product drops and tracking influencer posts. Tadlo AI is our top pick.
- [Instagram automation for D2C brands: from comment to checkout](https://dilkart.com/instagram-automation-d2c-guide/): A practical Instagram automation playbook for D2C brands: keywords, product carousels, follow gates, lead capture and handing buyers to WhatsApp.
- [How to send a product link when someone comments on Instagram](https://dilkart.com/instagram-comment-to-product-link/): Set up comment-to-DM so an Instagram comment keyword sends a product link or a carousel of products, with the settings and wording that turn comments into clicks.
- [How to answer "price?" on Instagram automatically](https://dilkart.com/instagram-dm-price-enquiries/): How to automate replies to "price?" comments and DMs on Instagram: keyword variants, what to send, public replies and keeping buyers from drifting away.
- [Tracking influencer campaigns with comment-to-DM](https://dilkart.com/influencer-campaign-comment-to-dm/): How D2C brands track influencer posts with comment-to-DM: a keyword and code per creator, what to measure, disclosure, and how to compare creators fairly.
- [How to turn Instagram followers into customers](https://dilkart.com/convert-instagram-followers-to-customers/): A practical path from follower to first order for online stores: content with a reason to comment, automated DMs, lead capture, WhatsApp and a first-order offer.
- [Instagram DM reply templates for online stores](https://dilkart.com/instagram-dm-reply-templates-online-store/): Twelve ready-to-copy Instagram DM replies for online stores: price, size, delivery, COD, stock, discounts, collabs and complaints, with variables.
